caption: The drawing shows an oval-shaped frame with a gold, rope-like border centered on a light beige, blank background. Inside the frame is a detailed depiction of a wreath composed of various flowers and leaves. The flowers and leaves are shaded with soft, natural tones including browns, purples, creams, and muted greens. The elements are arranged in a crescent shape, filling much of the oval, with each flower and leaf carefully rendered to show individual petals and textures. Near the bottom-left quadrant beneath the frame, the name "D.G. Campbell" is printed in small, light text. The overall composition is minimalistic, with the focus on the central floral wreath inside the oval and large areas of negative space surrounding the central motif.
title: Hair Ornament
